content.title: How to watch UCLA vs. UConn men’s basketball: Second Round TV channel and streaming options for March 22
content.text: The No. 2 seed UConn Huskies (30-5) will take to the court against the No. 7 seed UCLA Bruins (24-11) on Sunday with a spot in the Sweet 16 of the NCAA Tournament up for grabs. This matchup tips at 9:10 p.m. ET.How to watch UCLA Bruins vs. UConn Huskies Venue: Xfinity Mobile Arena Time: 9:10 p.m. ET TV: TNT Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. UCLA vs. UConn odds Spread: UConn -4.5 (-113), UCLA +4.5 (-110) Favorite Moneyline: UConn -193 Underdog Moneyline: UCLA +157 Total: 136.5 Total Over Odds: -110 Total Under Odds: -113 Odds provided by BetMGM.Stats to know UConn’s +432 scoring differential (outscoring opponents by 12.3 points per game) is a result of scoring 77.6 points per game (131st in college basketball) while giving up 65.3 per contest (11th in college basketball). UConn connects on 8.2 three-pointers per game (135th in college basketball) while shooting 34.7% from beyond the arc (141st in college basketball). It is making 2.2 more threes per contest than its opponents, who drain 6.0 per game while shooting 30.5%. UCLA is outscoring opponents by 6.7 points per game, with a +233 scoring differential overall. It puts up 77.7 points per game (127th in college basketball) and allows 71.0 per outing (98th in college basketball). UCLA connects on 7.9 three-pointers per game (167th in college basketball) at a 37.9% rate (20th in college basketball), compared to the 8.1 its opponents make, shooting 32.0% from beyond the arc.
